description: Schema for governance telemetry logs used in AI systems.

actor.description: Identity of the person or system initiating the action, supporting accountability.

decision_boundary.description: Boundaries or constraints that govern the AI decision at the moment of execution.

escalation_state.description: Current escalation status (e.g. normal, warning, critical) reflecting risk containment.

stop_authority_trigger.description: Indicates whether a stop authority mechanism has been triggered, evidencing human override.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp providing traceability for the event.

rationale.description: Explanation of the reasoning behind the action or decision, supporting audit defensibility.

intervention_result.description: Outcome of the action or intervention, used for continuous assurance.

additional_metadata.description: Optional metadata (e.g. model version, input features, risk scores) relevant for audit.
